title: Java 26.3 command and protocol qualification

source.note: This report and its documentation are committed after the tested code revision. No code changes are included in that documentation commit.

reference.method: Inspected Java 25 javap output for ServerGamePacketListenerImpl, BlockInput, FillCommand, and BlockStateParser from the named official JAR.
reference.note: The historical 2026-10-15 vanilla qualification is documented separately in IRONORE.md. This continuation executed Pumpkin only; no Minecraft EULA was accepted.

build.note: Built on the larger Linux worker after the connected VM proved memory constrained. Pinned dependencies and Cargo.lock were not changed. The development executable is not a performance benchmark.

validation.existing_toolchain_notice: Cargo reports a future-incompatibility notice for dependency proc-macro-error2 v2.0.1. The affected crates pass Clippy with no remaining lint diagnostics.

baseline.block_suite_note: Eleven behavior observations failed and the owned server required termination after /fill destroy hung. Restart checks did not run. The strict neighbor-update observation was added after this baseline run. These failures include dependent fixture failures, not eleven independent root causes.

block_parser_regressions.note: New parser regressions were run against the prior implementation before applying the fixes.

limits: Coverage establishes the recorded command, protocol, persistence, unit, and lint checks, not completion of the full vanilla port.
Pumpkin clocks remain per World; vanilla 26.3 uses shared server clock IDs.
Block NBT support uses existing Pumpkin block-entity serializers. Missing entity behavior and fields are outside this change.
Native Java client, survival gameplay, cross-dimension gameplay, and Bedrock acceptance were not performed.
Vanilla world migration and full save compatibility remain unqualified; Pumpkin DataVersion 4903 differs from vanilla 5023.
The Rust test and Clippy commands cover the named packages and default features, not every workspace package or feature combination.
No performance claims or release build qualification are made.

github_actions_note.note: The initial branch push unintentionally triggered this inherited workflow before skip-ci commits were in place. Subsequent code pushes triggered no workflows. The qualification above was run on Linux outside GitHub Actions.
